games.name: +1 Jetpack Evolution
games.desc:
🚀🚀🚀🚀🚀🚀🚀
In +1 Jetpack Evolution, your goal is to upgrade your jetpack by earning experience while flying through the world.

Gain XP by flying your jetpack, improve it step by step, and unlock stronger evolutions that let you fly faster and reach new heights.
Overcome obstacles and challenges to earn trophies, which can be used to multiply your experience and boost your progress even more.

The more you fly, the stronger your jetpack becomes.
How far can you evolve it? 🔥

games.name: [FORM] Dragon Ball Warriors
games.desc:
💫 Welcome to Dragon Ball Warriors!
Train your stats, unlock transformations, and master unique techniques to become the strongest warrior in the multiverse.

⚔️ Features
Epic Battles, Transformations, Dynamic Combat, and more!

🎮 PC Controls
[E] Combat | [Q] Ki Blast
[R] Train Defense | [C] Charge Ki
[G] Vanish | [Z] Toggle Aura
[B] Form | [V] Short Transformation
[N] Kaioken | [L] Block
[X] Scouter | [Double Jump] Fly

🎮 Controller (PS / Xbox)
[R2/RT] Combat | [L2/LT] Ki Blast
[R1/RB] Train Defense | [Square/X] Charge Ki
[Triangle/Y] Form | [Circle/B] Tap → Short Transformation
[Circle/B] Hold → Kaioken | [L1/LB] Tap → Block
[L1/LB] + [R1/RB] → Scouter
[L1/LB] + [Square/X] → Toggle Aura
[L3] Boost Flight | [Double A/Cross] Fly

🛡️ Join our community for updates! Use the in-game Report UI to report exploiters.
🌟 Like and favorite to support future updates!
